subject: Reseller addendum: evidence pack, SLA carveouts, and execution path
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora@cloudseller.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft reseller addendum & evidence pack — initial redlines

Hi Michael —

Thanks for the call yesterday. Attached is our initial redline to Redwood's reseller addendum (MSA + order form pass-through clauses). Two asks up front:

1) We need an evidence matrix showing where Redwood will provide audit artifacts (SOC 2, logging retention, invoice trail) so our finance and compliance teams can validate pass-through flow.
2) Regarding SLA carveouts: our procurement team requested a narrow exception for marketplace outages that originate in third-party marketplace infrastructure. The proposed language is in the redline (see section 5.c).

Can you confirm who on your side will own the evidence pack and a realistic timeline for review? We have a procurement committee meeting on Oct 22.

Attachments: cloudseller_reseller_addendum_v1_redline.docx (redline), evidence_matrix_SOC2-SLA.xlsx (blank template)

—Nora
Nora Patel
Head of Partnerships | CloudSeller Inc

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@cloudseller.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum & evidence pack — initial redlines

Nora — thanks for sending. Quick read-through attached and a proposed next-steps plan below.

Plan (high level):
- Laura (legal) will triage the redlines and highlight any absolute no-go items by EOD Oct 15.
- Ben (ops) and I will collate the evidence artifacts. Ben: can you confirm whether SOC 2 artifact delivery is possible via our secure share, and estimated retention logs export for invoice traceability?
- We should align on SLA carveout language; if it's limited to third-party marketplace system failures (and not Redwood serving runtime), we can likely accept a narrow carveout with monitoring/alerting obligations.

Deliverables and timings:
- EOD Oct 15: legal redline summary (Laura)
- Oct 16: evidence matrix draft populated by Ben
- Oct 19: final consolidated redline and recommended language from Redwood for CloudSeller procurement review (aiming to hit your Oct 22 committee)

If that timeline works, I'll circulate an internal mutual action plan doc and invite a brief triage call for Oct 15.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Head of Partner Sales | Redwood Inference

[Attachment: mg_quicknotes_reseller_addendum.pdf (notes)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora@cloudseller.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 08:57:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum & evidence pack — legal triage

Michael / Ben —

Reviewed the redline this morning. Primary legal points:

1) Indemnity & pass-through liability: CloudSeller's redline attempts to shift broader third-party marketplace liability to Redwood. We can accept limited pass-through for fees collected via the marketplace but cannot accept sweeping indemnity for upstream partner failures. Proposed compromise in my inline comments.

2) SLA carveout: We can agree to a carveout that references (a) the list of named third-party marketplace providers, and (b) a requirement for CloudSeller to provide timely incident tickets showing root cause. I added language requiring a 'best-efforts restoration' clause and preserving Redwood's SLA for its runtime and network.

3) Evidence pack: Ben, please fill the attached evidence_matrix_SOC2-SLA.xlsx with: SOC 2 report availability (pdf), security contact, retention window for invoice-related logs (S3 path + retention), and sample export of billed tokens with invoice id. Procurement will want timestamps and a contact for audit requests.

I'll convert my inline notes into a summary doc by EOD Oct 15 and attach a proposed consolidated redline.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: laura_summary_redline_notes.docx]

From: ops-team@cloudseller.com <ops-team@cloudseller.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Nora Patel <nora@cloudseller.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum & evidence pack — ops inputs

Hi team —

Ben, quick ops-level confirmation from CloudSeller:
- We can accept a named-provider carveout. We will supply incident tickets and a root-cause statement within 72 hours of a marketplace-origin outage.
- For SOC 2: we need a copy of Redwood's most recent Type II report (or at minimum, a SOC 2 letter of attestation) plus a secure inbox for audit artifacts.
- Regarding billing trails: CloudSeller requires a CSV export mapping Redwood invoice ids to marketplace transaction ids for reconciliation.

Nora — we'll plan to present this at procurement on Oct 22; the committee will want a single consolidated addendum and the evidence matrix filled.

Regards,
CloudSeller Ops
[Attachment: cloudseller_ops_requirements.pdf]

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Nora Patel <nora@cloudseller.com>, ops-team@cloudseller.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft reseller addendum & evidence pack — final coordination

Thanks — this is helpful. Quick commitments from Redwood: 

- Laura will send a consolidated redline that narrows the indemnity and formalizes the named-provider carveout language by COB Oct 16 (attached).
- Ben will populate the evidence_matrix_SOC2-SLA.xlsx with SOC 2 artifact availability (Type II date), secure share instructions, and a sample invoice->transaction export. Expect Ben's draft by close of business Oct 16.
- I'll circulate a mutual action plan in HubSpot and set a 30-minute triage call for Oct 19 to finalize language before your procurement meeting.

Nora/CloudSeller ops — for SOC 2: can you confirm who will receive the attestation (legal@redwood.com is fine) and whether a redacted Type II would suffice for the procurement committee?

Next steps:
- Oct 16 COB: consolidated redline + evidence matrix draft (Laura, Ben)
- Oct 19: triage call to sign off on language
- Oct 22: CloudSeller procurement review

Attachments in thread: cloudseller_reseller_addendum_v1_redline.docx, evidence_matrix_SOC2-SLA.xlsx, laura_summary_redline_notes.docx, cloudseller_ops_requirements.pdf

—Michael
Michael Grant
